correctness.rationale: For the monomial cyclic shift |T| and |T*| are commuting positive diagonals with eigenvalues a^j and a^(j+1 mod n). Their norm/numerical radius maxima reduce exactly to 1/4 max{U+V,Z+1}+1/2 max{P,Q}. For n=2 this is strictly increasing with max(theta,1-theta). For n>=3, F=U+V-Z-1 strictly decreases, with F(1/2)>0 and F((n-1)/n)<0; crossing tau is unique. On [1/2,tau], derivative has sign of strictly increasing G with G(1/2)<0; post-crossing branches are increasing. Thus the classified unique global optimizer and strict n>=3 gain follow. Verified exact rational n10,a=6/5,r=1 certificate using Fraction integers, and independent numeric n3 tau≈0.518032178392, Phi≈8.571894479<9 plus n10 smooth theta≈0.5484123. Finite tests supplement global analytic monotonicity, not an all-n proof.
